rule: reject if any pre-May split control_ratio >= 1.00
penalize 0.80 <= control_ratio < 1.00 instead of treating as clean seed
require label_t1 and label_t2 positive in validation/test/recent; require small dispersion between entry labels
require time-varying latent-neutral positive in all pre-May evaluation splits
rank by min(Newey-West, block-bootstrap, non-overlap offset) not naive hourly t-stat

do not expand direct OI x price seeds until a repaired selector passes dry-run and control audit
